title: Low Calorie Luxurious Ukrainian Cocoa Pudding
description: A rich and decadent Ukrainian dessert featuring cocoa, made in a traditional tandoor clay pot, with a focus on low calorie ingredients. This pudding is perfect for a romantic evening or special occasion.
instructions: Preheat the tandoor clay pot by filling it with boiling water and letting it sit for 10 minutes.
In a medium saucepan, whisk together the cocoa powder, almond milk, honey, cornstarch, vanilla extract, and salt.
Cook the mixture over medium heat, whisking constantly, until it comes to a boil.
Reduce the heat to low and simmer for 5 minutes, or until the pudding has thickened.
Remove the pudding from the heat and let it cool slightly.
In a separate bowl, whisk the egg whites until they become stiff peaks.
Fold the egg whites into the pudding until well combined.
Pour the pudding into the preheated tandoor clay pot and serve warm.
